en: A black-and-white photograph showing a well-maintained public square with garden landscaping, benches, and a central statue or monument. The square is surrounded by early 20th-century European-style buildings, including a large institutional-looking building with ornate architectural details and gabled roofs. The scene is tranquil, with a few people visible and a backdrop of trees and hills.
